decisions.reason: As a design-led line extension that stays very close to the core drainage business and remained visibly promoted after launch, management is likely to justify the investment and keep it unless demand clearly disappoints.

Because this product fits the firm's stated push toward modern, seamless and barrier-free bathroom architecture and has been publicly presented as a distinct innovation, management is likely to stay committed to it.

Although pump-based shower drainage looks more uncertain given the earlier disappearance of a related pump product, the firm has recently invested again in this direction and is likely to treat any weak early results as temporary rather than exit immediately.
